name: Peñarandilla (Spain)
description: Square flag chequy of 27 pieces, 14 red and 13 white, the upper hoist square charged with a yellow writing quill.
history: The flag and arms of Peñarandilla were adopted on 1 October 2019 after a historical study by the specialist Ricardo Gil Turrión; the flag is square, composed of 27 checks, 14 red and 13 white, with the upper hoist check charged with a yellow writing quill, referring to Mudéjar art and to Saint Teresa, whose last journeys are recalled by the book and quill of the arms.

features.role: chequy of 27 pieces in three columns of nine
writing quill on the upper hoist square
